slides.text: It all started when I complained about the pothole on 4th Street to a guy named 'Tony Two-Fingers' at my local deli. I just wanted the city council to fix it. The next morning, the mayor was on the news, crying, publicly apologizing to me while personally filling the pothole with asphalt in a tailored suit. Now, terrifying men in fedoras keep kissing my hand when I buy groceries.

I am a thirty-two-year-old actuary who collects Pokémon cards, but the entire criminal underworld thinks I'm the ruthless new kingpin of the city. Yesterday, a rival cartel boss sent me a severed horse head in a box. I panicked and mailed him back a polite thank-you card and a twenty-dollar Starbucks gift card, hoping to de-escalate. I thought I was dead for sure.

This morning, the rival boss showed up at my apartment building, sobbing. He hugged me aggressively. 'A gift card? You spared my family! You are truly a merciful Don!' he wept. He handed me the deed to a casino and left. I still don't know how to run a mafia empire, but I did order them to fix all the potholes in my neighborhood. My commute is flawless now.
